meta.name: Navarasa
meta.description:
From amusement to awe, the nine human emotions of Indian aesthetic theory are explored in this anthology series.

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

videos.title: Edhiri: Karuna
videos.overview: When a young man unleashes years of pent-up rage on a stranger who wronges his brother, the aftermath reveal layers of regret and resentment.

videos.title: Summer of 92: Hasya
videos.overview: Invited back to his alma mater to speak, a popular actor takes the school's stage to recount his reckless, ridiculous antics as an unacademic teen.

videos.title: Project Agni: Adbhuta
videos.overview: Fixated on his radical theory on the human subconscious, a brilliant thinker realizes his ideas' potential, and risks, as he shares them with a friend.

videos.title: Payasam: Bheebhatsa
videos.overview: Envious of his nephew's success in life, a discontented villager's simmering insecurity and resentment rear their ugly heads at a family wedding.

videos.title: Peace: Shanthih
videos.overview: A group of soldiers face risky choices when a young boy, separated from his family while fleeing home, seeks their help in making a rescue.

videos.title: Roudhram: Raudra
videos.overview: Detained after committing a physical assault, a young man reflects on the troubling events that led to his action and its painful impact on his family.

videos.title: Inmai: Bhaya
videos.overview: An ordinary day takes a frightful — and fateful — turn for a young woman when a stranger arrives at her home.

videos.title: Thunintha Pin: Veera
videos.overview: A new official's grit and guts are tested when, after an ambush in the field, he is tasked with transporting a wily captive to police headquarters.

videos.title: Guitar Kambi Mele Nindru: Sringara
videos.overview: A musician hopes to jump-start his stagnant career overseas, but on the cusp of his departure, he meets a vocalist who sweeps him off his feet.
